notes.title: Update Notes for march 7
notes.content:
Our engineering gnomes are proud to offer these release notes:

[b]WIDE SCREEN DUNGEONS[/b]
We've enhanced our dungeon art to support wide-screen views. So go full screen!

[b]INTO THE BREACH[/b]
After the dwarf charges, any monster that is adjacent to the dwarf, other than the target, will panic and skip its next turn. Previously, only monsters adjacent to both the dwarf and the target would panic. And the Frenzy II skill has been changed to this: +3 when charging into frenzy. Frenzy II is now what Frenzy III used to be: Flames also count towards frenzy bonus. These changes will improve the dwarf’s ability to plunge himself into the middle of battle.

[b]IMPROVED DAILY HUNT STANDINGS[/b]
The standings page now includes a Daily Hunt section showing the top ten players for the current hunt and the top 5 players for the previous 6 hunts. For players who hunted more than once, only their best score is shown. The hero used for each hunt will be shown, although games prior to this release will all show the human as the hero. We also changed the hunt so that the difficulty of the region affects how many scrolls you start with rather than the weapon bonus.

[b]MITHRIL ON A ROCK[/b]
The art for the mithril vest no longer looks like you are buying it in a store. You will now find it draped across a rock. And mithril will only be found on the top side of a room.

[b]NEW BULL RUSH[/b]
The swordsman can now bull rush monsters that start with 2 or more health, but only when they have been reduced to one health, and never into a pit. He can also bull rush monsters with greater than 5 defense.

[b]ELVEN HUNTRESS ADUSTMENTS[/b]
The elf's Prowl ability has been changed to a multi-part skill:

Prowl: 50% less likely to be caught sneaking. 
Prowl II: Chance to remain unseen after stealth bow attacks: 30% if you hit, 70% if you miss. 
Prowl III: Gain an additional +2 to surprise sword attacks. 

The above Prowl skill replaces the Long Shot skill, which has been changed to a natural Range ability: The elf has +1 to bow range. Thus you have no distance penalty for using your bow from 3 tiles away, and you can use your bow from 4 away, with the -3 distance penalty.

That's all for now. Carry on.

notes.title: New Swordsman Ability: Stomp
notes.content:
The human swordsman has undergone these changes:

1. His [b]punt[/b] ability has been replaced with [b]stomp[/b]: if your prior action was to kill an adjacent monster with your sword, you can take a free move (stomp) onto the tile where it died.

2. He can now only shove a monster into a pit if the pit is directly behind the monster or if he has a press bonus.

3. His chance of parrying is increased 20 percentage points when guarding. (eg. If your normal parry chance is 30%, it will be 50% if guarding.)

Now go crush your enemies.

notes.title: Windowed Mode is Now Supported
notes.content:
You can now switch between full screen and windowed mode. From the options menu, click “Toggle Fullscreen." 

Other changes since our EA release last month:

- More XP for dragons
- Reapers can follow you to any region other than dragon lairs
- Modifications to the dwarf's charge and elf's leap attack skills
- Standardization of which regions wandering monsters appear in
- Changes to how heroes deal with slimes

For update details, see the in-game News section.

[u]What we're working on now:[/u]
- The Steam Overlay
- A new skill ("Stride") for the human swordsman
- Achievements

notes.title: Tunics & Tankards Challenge is On!
notes.content:
Any Steam player who slays a green dragon during Next Fest (June 16-22) gets a free t-shirt when buying anything else in the Dungeoneers merchandise store. 

Slaying a green dragon requires 3 successful dungeon runs, which can take, in total, from 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on your knack for dungeoneering.

Our store features dozens tunics (shirts), tankards (mugs), and helms (hats). You can get there from within the game by going to the Village page, then click Store on the left menu. 

Steps to get your T-Shirt:

- Defeat a green dragon (or better), from June 16-22, using the Dungeoneers demo.
- Copy the code from the in-game message.
- Go to our store (on left menu from Village page).
- Select two or more items, at least one of which is a t-shirt
- In checkout, enter the discount code which you will receive in-game after slaying a green dragon. Doing so will make one t-shirt free (as long as there is still something else in the cart that you are buying).
- Complete checkout by paying for the remaining items and shipping, and the merchandise will be sent to you.
- Wear with pride, dragon slayer.
